concept.title: Profile comparison workflow
concept.shortdesc: Compare helps review the saved setting differences between two profiles without changing either profile.

conbody.p: The workflow is: open Compare from the Library, search independently for Profile A and Profile B, review each selected profile summary, then read the comparison table.
The table uses the union of policy and managed-preference settings from both profiles. A row can be equal, changed, or missing on one side. Compare is read-only and does not merge values.
Use Compare when deciding whether two saved profiles are equivalent, whether one profile missed a setting, or whether a policy or preference changed between versions.
